Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the final comparison step by swapping the birthdates of the two directors. While the retrieved data correctly identified Orestis Laskos as born in 1907 and Sam Irvin as born in 1956, the Planner's final conclusion incorrectly stated that Orestis Laskos was born on 1956-06-14 and Sam Irvin was born on 1907-11-11. This misattribution of dates led to the wrong conclusion that the director of "Allos Gia To Ekatommyrio" was born later, when in reality, Sam Irvin (born 1956) was born later than Orestis Laskos (born 1907).
